treaty_name: Convention between Ireland and the Republic of Turkey for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and capital gains (2008)

rates.quote: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends, to the extent that they are paid out of profits that have been subject to tax in Turkey as specified in paragraph 5, where the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the voting power of the company paying the dividends;

10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends where the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the voting power of the company paying the dividends;
15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases;

5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends where the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the voting power of the company paying the dividends;
15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed: a. 10 per cent of the gross amount of such interest where it is paid in respect of a loan or other debt claim for a period exceeding two years or if the interest is received by a financial institution; b. 15 per cent of the gross amount of the interest in all other cases.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

notes: Art. 28: EIF on receipt of later notification (2010-08-18 per Turkish GIB list); effect in Turkey for taxable periods beginning on/after 1 Jan 2011, Ireland from year of assessment / financial year beginning 1 Jan 2011. Turkish-source 5% tier requires profits subject to full Turkish corporation tax (Art. 10(5)). Interest capped at 10% for loans/debt-claims exceeding two years or interest received by a financial institution (Art. 11(2)(a)) - not modelled as separate tier; general 15%. No government/central bank interest exemption in Art. 11. Branch profits tax capped at 5% (Art. 10(4)). Royalties include equipment rental and contingent alienation gains. Protocol: for Turkey 'dividends' include investment fund/trust income. MLI: Turkiye is a signatory but not yet a Party (treaties_merged.json, OECD status 15-09-2026), so no MLI PPT; treaty has no general PPT clause. Revenue publishes no synthesised text for Turkey (consistent).
